title: Literally Just Backpacks
description: I don't know what else to tell you, it literally adds a backpack.
body: I don't really like mods that add complicated backpacks, so I made this one that adds a super simple backpack, made with leather, string, and a chest. I made this one mainly just for my personal use, but why not publish it so others can use it too? Unlike other mods I have made, this one does not have any dependencies.
